title: The Episode About Banda Singh's Capture

blocks.text: Banda is dragged out, confined in an iron cage, and chained heavily, while the accompanying Sikhs are also bound for the long procession toward Delhi.
Yet the prisoners remain spiritually unconquered: they sing, recite, and convert suffering into joy by treating captivity as another form of witness.
The iron cage becomes the visual emblem of Mughal victory and Sikh endurance at the same time.
